title: Snap a meal
intro: Log what you eat in seconds, or check where a Living Dose product came from.

photo.title: Take a photo of your plate
photo.body: It's saved with your diary entry, so you and your dietitian can look back on it.
photo.error: That photo couldn't be read. Please try another.

plate.title: What's on your plate?
plate.body: Search and add each part of your meal, then pick the portion size.
plate.noResults: Nothing found. Try a simpler word, like rice or soup.

review.title: Check and save
review.saltHigh: That's quite a lot of salt for one meal. Adults should have under 5 g in a whole day.
review.estimates: These are estimates. Home-cooked portions vary.

diary.title: Today's food diary
diary.removeConfirm: Delete this meal from your diary?
diary.planNote: Meals you tick in your meal plan are counted on your Home page.

guest.title: Sign in to keep a food diary
guest.body: Your meals, photos and totals are private to you.

product.title: Scan a product
product.body: Every Living Dose product has a code on the label. Scan it to see where your food came from.
product.cameraHelp: Point your camera at the QR code on the label.
product.cameraError: We couldn't open the camera. You can type the code instead.
product.noCamera: Camera scanning isn't available in this browser. Type the code printed under the QR code instead.
product.invalid: We don't recognise that code. Check it matches the label, for example LD-UGU-B0930.
product.harvested_other: Harvested up to {{count}} days before packing
product.packed: Checked and packed at the Living Dose hub, Lagos
product.noTrace: This product is made in our kitchen from traceable ingredients.
